title: Admin updates System Settings
description: Update club branding and tournament defaults from System Settings: Club Name, Club Timezone, Round Robin and Multi Round Robin rules, and Public Achievements. Changes stay local until you Save.

steps.title: System Settings
steps.body: Club Name and Timezone stay at the top. Tournament Rules and Public Achievements are expandable sections below.

steps.title: Edit Club Name
steps.body: Club Name appears in the header and public surfaces. Type the new display name for the club.

steps.title: Name and timezone
steps.body: Set Club Name to “Portland TT Club Showcase” and Club Timezone to America/New_York. Timezone drives club calendar days for check-in and midnight jobs.
steps.resultNote: Club Name and Timezone updated in the form (not saved yet).

steps.title: Open Tournament Rules
steps.body: Expand Tournament Rules to tune format minima used when organizers create events.

steps.title: Round Robin settings
steps.body: Round Robin controls min/max players and Early Complete Min %. Here Early Complete is set to 80%.
steps.resultNote: Round Robin subsection open with Early Complete Min % = 80.

steps.title: Open Multi Round Robins
steps.body: Multi Round Robins settings include minimum roster size and the default players-per-group size.

steps.title: Multi RR settings
steps.body: Default Size is the suggested group size when creating a Multi Round Robin. Here it is set to 5.
steps.resultNote: Multi Round Robins open with Default Size = 5.

steps.title: Open Public Achievements
steps.body: Public Achievements controls how many results each board shows on the public achievements page (0 hides a board).

steps.title: Achievements configured
steps.body: Use Set all to and Apply to all to publish every board with the same list length — here 10 results each.
steps.resultNote: Public Achievements set to 10 for all boards via Apply to all.

steps.title: Save System Settings
steps.body: Apply all of the branding, tournament-rule, and achievement edits, then Save. The floating bar shows Unsaved changes until you confirm.

steps.title: Settings saved
steps.body: The bar returns to All saved. Club Name, Timezone, RR / Multi RR defaults, and achievement boards are now live for the club.
